components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). Optional.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when
            structured address fields are supplied it is returned as the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code. When present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: Canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('DR who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate formatted 'FY<YY>', where the fiscal year starts on 1 July.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same last name and address) that opted in via sharesHousehold.
              type: string
              example: 3F2A1B0C
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: Points score set on creation - starts at 0, +2 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, +3 for a tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Numeric level from 1 to 4 mapped from membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or UNKNOWN when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: IANA timezone name derived from the locality (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane).
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: Segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' - TIER is PREMIUM when membershipLevel is 3 or more else STANDARD, AREA is METRO when locality is a known region (NSW/VIC/QLD) else REGIONAL.
              type: string
              example: PREMIUM_METRO
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: EMAIL when an email is present, otherwise PHONE.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: Age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate - MINOR (under 18), ADULT (18-64) or SENIOR (65+). Absent when birthDate is not set.
              type: string
              enum: [MINOR, ADULT, SENIOR]
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created today at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already holds 40-49 owners, approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode but uses a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates, when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE, otherwise false. A soft-deleted owner is retained and still readable but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit` field. Verified against the audit output: `memberId=NSW2716E6609E1` = region `NSW` + fiscal year `27` + HASH8 `16E6609E` + Luhn CHK `1`.

**What changed (kept deliberately small per file):**

- **`Owner.java`** — renamed the persisted field/column `customerCode`/`customer_code` → `memberId`/`member_id` and its getter/setter. No other method touched.
- **`CustomerCodes.java`** — repurposed the existing `build`/`deduplicate` pair (rather than adding a new class, to avoid a file) to emit the memberId: `region + FY(2) + hash8 + Luhn(base)`, with collision handling now keyed on `getMemberId()`. The FY is derived from `BusinessDays.roll(registrationDate ?? now)` so it matches the date `@PrePersist` will store — this also fixed the initial NPE (memberId is built before persist sets the date).
- **`CheckDigit.java`** — removed `of(Owner)` (it read `customerCode`); kept the reusable `luhn`, now used as the CHK segment.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — dropped the `membershipNumber` and `checkDigit` mappings; `memberId` auto-maps from the same-named entity property, so no explicit mapping was needed.
- **`OwnerAuditListener.java`** — audit records now reference `memberId` instead of `customerCode`/`membershipNumber`.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — one-line change: `setMemberId(CustomerCodes.build(...))`.
- **`openapi.yml`** — replaced the three field schemas with a single `memberId` (drives DTO generation, so the JSON no longer exposes the old fields).
- **`schema.sql`** — renamed the column (same position, so positional `data.sql` inserts still work; widened to `VARCHAR(32)`).

**Structural-impact notes:** I put the new construction logic in the small `CustomerCodes`/`CheckDigit` helper classes (low surrounding complexity) rather than growing the large controller or entity, touched only one line of the big `addOwner` method, and avoided a new file by reusing the existing build/dedup pair.
